source: Own measurement on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json: draw 1, 12 episodes, 2 per unit): the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) through the pinned engine (vendor/ale bfb7505), mean_episode_credit 1.0, every unit 1.0. First measured by the author on 2026-11-17: five ale validate runs of the tree of commit 5294e2d (validate-2bf900ec, validate-8381d436, validate-a7486572, validate-af689864 and validate-c2e25d1d), 12 of 12 episodes scored in each. Measured again by the maintainers on 2026-11-18 after their fixes (amendment 1 in tests/hidden/episode_selection.json: the grader, the simulator's table and renderer cache, the reference's wire and the verifier image changed; the set did not): one full verify under ale validate from a clean checkout of commit 27fd79f, run validate-6c2983f9, in the separate verifier's own image (tests/Dockerfile): mean_episode_credit 1.0, 12 of 12 episodes at credit 1.0, no aborts, no simulation faults, the numerics check and the render self-test passed, untouched 0.0, probe pairs 1242 of 1479 differing, the controller's time 608 s of the 9000 s budget. Measured again on 2026-11-19 after the difficulty round (amendment 2: the credit is the centrifuge run's; the set and the simulator did not change): one full verify under ale validate from a clean checkout of commit 37d05fc, run validate-de5885fa: mean_episode_credit 1.0, 12 of 12 episodes at credit 1.0 with the same number of steps and the same probe pairs (1242 of 1479 differing) as in validate-6c2983f9, no aborts, no simulation faults, untouched 0.0, the controller's time 498 s of the 9000 s budget.
note: Measured, not drawn. The set holds only episodes on which the reference scored credit 1.0 in three runs over the real wire when it was selected (tests/hidden/episode_selection.json), and again in the amendment's full verify. Since the fixes of 2026-11-18 the reference answers nothing from the clock and the simulation's numerics are pinned and checked, so a verify of the reference repeats. full_at 0.98 is kept under the run credit of 2026-11-19: two cold tubes missed over the set (0.0056 or 0.0083 of the metric each, with a complete run) still give reward 1.0; a run that does not count costs its whole episode (0.083 of the metric), so the reference reaches reward 1.0 only with all twelve runs complete. Its longest episode runs 19828 of the 20000 steps and repeats step for step.
